textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 english · Conquering the Summit · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Arunima comes from Ambedkar Nagar, a small district in Uttar Pradesh. Her father was an army engineer and her mother a health supervisor, and sports were a big part of the family's life.

beats.en: Arunima comes from Ambedkar Nagar, a small district in Uttar Pradesh. Her father was an army engineer and her mother a health supervisor, and sports were a big part of the family's life.
beats.speakEn: Arunima comes from Ambedkar Nagar, a small district in Uttar Pradesh. Her father was an army engineer and her mother a health supervisor, and sports were a big part of the family's life.

beats.en: She received a prosthetic leg and underwent physiotherapy. During this time, inspired by an article about Mount Everest, she resolved to climb the highest peak in the world.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 english · Conquering the Summit · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: On 21 May 2013, after 52 exhausting days, Arunima reached the summit of Mount Everest. She felt a surge of emotions, pride, relief and an overwhelming sense of achievement.
